## Frequently asked questions

### Where is EPS Interior Industries?
No. L10, SIDCO Guindy Industrial Estate, Chennai 600 032.

### What facilities does EPS Interior Industries have?
Luxury home & villa interiors, Corporate office interiors, Office renovation, Showroom & boutique interiors, Hotel & restaurant interiors, Hospital & lab interiors, Industrial & factory interiors, Modular kitchens & wardrobes, False ceilings & acoustics, Electrical, plumbing & HVAC, ISO 9001:2015 certified.

### Do you subcontract the work?
No. EPS Interior Industries designs, manufactures and executes in-house, with its own factory in SIDCO Guindy.

### How do payments work?
40% advance to source materials and start production, 40% after inspection before final finishing, and 20% at handover.

### How do I book a site visit with EPS Interior Industries?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 99405 40702. Open Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 8 pm.
